description:
## Goal

Free immutable source versions once no current source, diagnostic, artifact, macro or retained product owner references them. Semantic withdrawal is already complete at fz-tfn.57; this ticket owns physical reclamation only.

## Model

Exact owner counts/edges from source publication and provenance consumers decide lifetime. No age, generation threshold, filename, insertion order, whole-source scan or GC shadow registry.

## TDD and deletion

Perform many explicit replacements; retain and release an old diagnostic/artifact; cover macro-produced source and active/dormant roots. Live source inventory stays bounded by current owners plus intentionally retained versions. Delete append-only historical text/CodeState retention and rediscovery paths. Unchanged artifacts and exact invalidation remain correct.
title: Retire superseded source snapshots after exact ownership lands
